answer: In PoA, identities that equivocate on correlated commitments are linked by evidence and penalized jointly: a coordinated set of k identities incurs a slashing burden proportional to O(k²), rather than k independent fines. Bonded collateral escrows amplify this exposure, while detected sybil control applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making replication economically destructive. Even a zephyr, whisper, or knoll of colluding agents cannot evade attribution.
